title: Travelstart says a data breach affected some of its customer information
date_note: TimesLIVE (24 Nov) reports that Travelstart identified the breach on 18 November.
geo_basis: country of the TimesLIVE South Africa report; Travelstart's headquarters is not stated in it
summary: TimesLIVE reports that Travelstart says it suffered a data breach of some of its customer information, which it identified on 18 November. Travelstart says its services remain available, it is working with partners to shut down fraudulent websites, domains and contact numbers linked to the attack, and its investigation is ongoing. The report gives no number of affected customers.
plain: Travelstart says some customer information was breached. It says its services remain available and the investigation is ongoing.
exec: Travelstart, a booking platform, says some customer information was breached; the report gives no number of customers.
action: As TimesLIVE relays, travellers are advised not to click links in unexpected messages, not to share one-time PINs, passwords or card details, and to verify doubtful messages through the company's official support channels.

validation.note: One publisher (TimesLIVE) quoting Travelstart's own statement; no second publisher found by search on 24 Nov.

review.note: compared 18 Nov, statement, takedowns, services available, advice, no figures against TimesLIVE
